artifact_delivered: QAE threshold calibration across 10 assets (SPY, QQQ, AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL, AMZN, TSLA, NVDA, META, BTC-USD). Key finding: QAE amplifies underlying strategy rather than fixing it. When classical Sharpe > 0: QAE adds +0.2-0.4. When classical Sharpe < 0: QAE can save it (+0.9-2.4). When classical is marginal: QAE hurts. Optimal QAE threshold correlates with asset's volatility P90. QAE is NOT a universal enhancer — it is an amplifier of the base strategy.
